posts.description: Bindora converts your documents to PDF, extracts the text using OCR, and stores everything locally on your phone. Simple, private, and no subscription required.

posts.name: Expert Chase for iOS & Android
posts.tagline: Where human life runs with AI
posts.description: Our users wanted it, now they've got it. Introducing Expert Chase for iOS & Android, along with a powerful new experience and native integrations. Expert Chase is now available on Web, iOS, and Android, with support for both the Apple and Google ecosystems. Integrations include: Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Apple Reminders, Google Tasks, Apple Health, Google Health Connect.

posts.name: Whorl
posts.tagline: A generative design tool. No AI. Lots of play.
posts.description: Generative design tool for mesmerizing visuals, still and in motion. Posters for events, brand and presentation assets, music-video loops, conference identities, etc. All from play: make something unique in seconds, or spend hours creating. Runs in your browser on desktop or tablet.

posts.name: PicExhibit
posts.tagline: Deliver, proof and sell a shoot from one link.
posts.description: Deliver, proof and sell a shoot from one link. Client galleries, proofing, invoices, contracts and print sales for photographers.

posts.name: Scanara
posts.tagline: Scan your repo. Know your EU AI Act risk. Ship the dossier.
posts.description: Scanara scans your GitHub repos — code and documents — and tells you whether your AI systems are compliant with the EU AI Act. No questionnaires, no consultants, no 3-6 month documentation sprint. How it works: 🔍 Connect a repo — Scan runs gainst your code and docs 📊 Automatic risk classification — Annex III high-risk categories, mapped from what your AI system actually does 📄 Compliance dossier generated from findings 🔒 Immutable audit trail

posts.name: Vistree
posts.tagline: Reorganize markdown structure as a mindmap and re-export
posts.description: Vistree visualizes your markdown heading structure as a horizontal mindmap. Drag nodes to reorder sections, move them across heading depths (h2 becomes h3 automatically), and export clean markdown. Built for long markdown files, AI-generated docs, handoff memos, READMEs, where scrolling and manual cut-and-paste breaks your flow. Unlike read-only visualizers like Markmap, Vistree lets you restructure your document and get markdown back. No signup. No install. Runs in the browser.

posts.name: PactKeeper - One promise. Every day.
posts.tagline: One promise a day. A streak that means something.
posts.description: PactKeeper is a daily accountability app. Pick one commitment, check in each evening (done, missed, or partial), and get a short AI witness line — not advice, just an honest observation. No account needed. One pact at a time, kept honestly.

posts.name: Übungszeit
posts.tagline: Practise German with an AI tutor — all four skills
posts.description: A hundred apps teach you German. Übungszeit is where you practise it. Read, listen, write and speak from A1 to C1 while Helfen — your AI tutor — reviews your work, explains every mistake, and brings it back before you forget. No account needed to start.

posts.name: Aquiplex
posts.tagline: The AI that understands your digital world
posts.description: Aqua already knows your projects, your files and what you decided last week. Stop rebuilding your context at the start of every conversation.

posts.name: WishCurator
posts.tagline: One list for every store
posts.description: WishCurator watches prices on the things you want across Amazon, eBay, Shein, AliExpress and more, and tells you when they drop. Sort saves into buckets, see every item's price history, and share a list with friends. Android, free, no ads.

posts.name: Leader Finder
posts.tagline: The go-to companion for Hitman: WOA Freelancer
posts.description: A fan-made iOS app to help Hitman Freelancer players identify syndicate leaders. Filter targets by hair color, accessories, and distinguishing features to find your mark fast.

posts.name: GrowthLens
posts.tagline: Website and YouTube audits with actionable growth plans
posts.description: GrowthLens helps website owners and YouTube creators identify growth bottlenecks using publicly accessible signals. It produces structured scores, practical recommendations, and downloadable consultant-style reports covering website visibility, trust, conversion readiness, channel positioning, content strategy, audience growth, and monetisation readiness.

posts.name: RaisDB
posts.tagline: The database client for the AI era
posts.description: A database client built for the AI era. Connect 40+ engines from one app — PostgreSQL, Sqlite, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse, plus vector databases like Qdrant, Chroma, Milvus,Weaviate, and Pinecone. The native AI Agent reads your schema and writes SQL for you. Built-in MCP server lets AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more — read and operate on your databases directly. Rust core. Local-first.

posts.name: Routevia
posts.tagline: Plan your Türkiye trip with AI, day by day
posts.description: Routevia turns your must-see list into an AI-powered, day-by-day itinerary across Türkiye. Add cities and sights, get an optimized route with travel times, and explore 80+ regional guides — free to start on iOS and Android.

posts.name: KinetSoul — 心事，只在你手机里
posts.tagline: Your private AI companion — thoughts stay on your phone.
posts.description: Your thoughts stay on your phone.** KinetSoul is an AI emotional companion that runs **fully offline by default**. Talk through your day, track your mood, and feel heard — without your most private conversations ever leaving your device. No account. No login. No tracking. No ads. No backend servers.

posts.name: GearFlow – Shared Gear Checklists
posts.tagline: Shared gear checklists for teams, events, and trips
posts.description: GearFlow combines shared gear checklists with practical event logistics. Teams can organize equipment by activity and location, assign items to specific vehicles, coordinate packing through cloud sync, and track what is ready or still missing. Unlike a basic checklist app, GearFlow connects equipment, destinations, transport, and team progress in one workflow.

posts.name: HDM
posts.tagline: Find out exactly why your team keeps stalling
posts.description: A 12-question diagnostic across four domains — Cognitive, Emotional, Behavioural, Environmental — that reveals where your hesitation comes from, instantly.

posts.name: Zapdir
posts.tagline: Drop notes and files. Pick them up anywhere.
posts.description: Zapdir helps you quickly share notes and files between your devices. Paste, upload, and access them anywhere with a simple link.

posts.name: FlugelDPP
posts.tagline: Enterprise Product Passport Infrastructure by Flugelsoft
posts.description: FlugelDPP is the enterprise B2B SaaS platform for EU ESPR Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 compliance. Automate W3C DIDs, Polygon & IPFS ledger seals, SAP/ERP webhooks, and factory QR printing across Batteries, Textiles, Cosmetics, Construction & Luxury.

posts.name: AKNMIMM
posts.tagline: Manage your social media growth, all in one place
posts.description: Most YouTube tools are built for agencies. AKNMIMM is built for the creator doing everything alone. Analytics, scheduling, metadata editing, and comment management — all in one place. No switching between tabs. No paying for five different subscriptions. No features you'll never use. Built for the 1K–100K creator who is serious about growing but not big enough for the expensive tools to make sense. Try it at aknmimm.com

posts.name: SKI
posts.tagline: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
posts.description: We just built SKI — voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more. It's not dictation: your agent answers you out loud, like a real teammate, so you build at the speed you think. You can even bring it into a meeting to build live, or send it in your place to speak for you. It's an ambient thing that just sits on your desktop — hit a key, talk, it works. All on your machine, free. Available on Mac & Windows.

posts.name: Virtual Hair Try On
posts.tagline: Try hairstyles on your photo before you cut or dye
posts.description: Upload a portrait, choose a cut, color, bangs, or style, and preview it on your own face before committing at the salon. Unlike a simple filter, Virtual Hair Try On also asks salon-style questions and turns the result into practical guidance you can save and show your stylist.

posts.name: AIToolsHub
posts.tagline: The world's largest AI tools directory
posts.description: Explore 100,000+ AI tools across 50+ categories. C🚀 AIToolsHub is the world's largest curated AI tools directory. After seeing countless AI tools launch every day with no central place to discover them, I built AIToolsHub. What makes us different: ✓ 100K+ AI tools across 50+ categories ✓ Side-by-side comparison (up to 4 tools) ✓ 5 languages with full RTL Arabic support ✓ AI-powered semantic search ✓ Free API access ✓ Dark/light mode ✓ Bookmarks, collections, reviews Try it: https://bakrr.net
